card.name: Digits and slashes inside liquid volumes
card.fires_on: The digit 2 in the decimal 1.25 mL before a ritonavir volume, and the slash in strengths such as 125 mg/5 mL. Also fires once on the word 'relatively' before 'fresh water'.

modes.label: Decimal volume digit
modes.description: The 2 in 1.25 mL of ritonavir oral solution in darunavir dosing tables.

modes.label: Slash in concentration
modes.description: The slash between mg amount and mL volume in oral suspension strengths.
